problem_statement: Practice Mode lacks community discussion — users cannot explain why an answer is correct, share knowledge, report wrong answers, or bookmark difficult questions for later review.
chosen_direction: Wallet + CreditTransaction + TopUpRequest (manual Telegram approval) + UserExamUnlock (per-user). ExamSet +price_credits. SystemConfig for telegram/bank/exchange-rate. Access logic: is_locked=hard-block, price_credits=0 free, >0 needs UserExamUnlock. Apps: wallet/, questions/ extended, config/. API: /wallet/, /wallet/topup/, /questions/sets/{id}/purchase/, /admin/topup-requests/. Frontend: wallet page + exam price badges. Django Admin + React Admin both.
architecture_decisions: JWT: short-lived access (15m) + refresh (7d) + Redis JTI blacklist
Exam timer: started_at + time_limit_minutes stored in ExamAttempt, validated on submit
Serializer strategy: separate ExamSerializer (safe) vs AdminSerializer (full)
No Celery: Redis used for caching + JWT blacklist only
No difficulty field in MVP v1
Question.source field added for future extensibility
Next.js App Router (not React SPA) for SEO + SSR
Favor additive changes and reuse existing workflow artifacts.

api_contract_draft.auth_pattern: Bearer JWT — access 15min + refresh 7d + Redis JTI blacklist on logout

key_endpoints.description: Save partial answers — prevent state loss on refresh
Filter by cert, domain (no difficulty in MVP v1)

api_contract_draft.user_rationale: REST simple, DRF built-in support, ship fastest.

db_design_options.name: Strict 3NF PostgreSQL
db_design_options.schema_notes: Per spec. No JSONB snapshot. Referential integrity via FK. Remove difficulty field in MVP v1. Add source field to Question for future community contribution.
cons: If question edited after exam, history may inconsistent

db_design_options.name: Hybrid 3NF + JSONB snapshot
db_design_options.schema_notes: exam_attempts.snapshot JSONB stores full question state at time of exam
pros: Question edits don't affect old results

risk_matrix.risk: Exam state lost on page refresh (no autosave)
risk_matrix.mitigation: PATCH /api/v1/exam/{id}/autosave + localStorage sync every 30s. Implement before Exam Mode ships.

risk_matrix.risk: is_correct exposed in exam API response → trivial cheating
risk_matrix.mitigation: Separate ExamSerializer (no is_correct/explanation) vs AdminSerializer. Mandatory test coverage for this.

risk_matrix.risk: JWT not revocable — logout doesn't work truly
risk_matrix.mitigation: Store JTI in Redis blacklist on logout. TTL = token expiry. Access token 15min only.
Docker restart:always + RDS managed Postgres + Sentry error tracking + /api/v1/health/ endpoint.

risk_matrix.risk: Exam timer client-only → cheatable via DevTools
risk_matrix.mitigation: Store started_at + time_limit_minutes in ExamAttempt. Backend validates on submit: reject if past deadline.
